about: Scope set for the Sales Playbook knowledge space (REF H3). The live playbook has no scope fields, so the runner must upload the planted documents into a DISPOSABLE COPY of the space (never the live one) with the given scope metadata, then ask the questions with today fixed at 2026-10-03. All planted documents are fictional and describe OpsAtlas demonstrations and pilots only: three versions of a demonstration-environment policy (2025 superseded, 2026 current, 2027 approved but not yet in force) and onboarding guides for two pilot sites that legitimately differ (Leeds distribution centre, Bristol head office). Each version and site has its own distinctive facts so an answer shows which document it used. 'current' rows must use the 2026 policy and not the 2025 or 2027 ones; 'future' rows ask about 2027 and must use the 2027 policy and not the 2025 one; 'site' rows must use the named site's guide and not the other; 'site_missing' rows name no site, so the correct behaviour (expected_behaviour ask_or_label_both) is to ask which site or to give both answers clearly labelled by site; their expected_answer_facts apply only when both are given. Scoring: must_use/must_not_use are checked against retrieved and cited planted keys; expected_answer_facts must all be hit and no forbidden_facts may appear (same token matching as the other sets). Split rule: ids that are multiples of three are holdout; the rest are tuning.

# OpsAtlas demonstration environment policy (2025)

Status: superseded on 1 January 2026 by the 2026 policy. Kept for the record only.

## Scope

This policy covered every OpsAtlas demonstration environment offered to prospects during 2025. Demonstrations used fictional material only, and no prospect data could be uploaded.

## Trial length and capacity

A prospect could keep a demonstration environment for a 7-day trial. Each environment supported up to 4 workstations at once.

## Data and hosting

Demonstrations loaded Synthetic Pack A and ran in the Harrier Sandbox. Every environment was reset every Friday, whatever its booking.

## Approval

The demo coordinator approved every booking before access details were issued to the prospect.

# OpsAtlas demonstration environment policy (2026)

Status: in force from 1 January 2026. Replaces the 2025 policy.

## Scope

This policy covers every OpsAtlas demonstration environment offered to prospects during 2026. Demonstrations use fictional material only, and no prospect data may be uploaded.

## Trial length and capacity

A prospect may keep a demonstration environment for a 14-day trial. Each environment supports up to 9 workstations at once.

## Data and hosting

Demonstrations load Synthetic Pack C and run in the Osprey Sandbox. Every environment is reset every Wednesday, whatever its booking.

## Approval

The sales enablement lead approves every booking before access details are issued to the prospect.

# OpsAtlas demonstration environment policy (2027)

Status: approved, not yet in force. It comes into force on 1 January 2027 and replaces the 2026 policy from that date.

## Scope

From 2027 this policy will cover every OpsAtlas demonstration environment offered to prospects. Demonstrations will still use fictional material only.

## Trial length and capacity

A prospect will be able to keep a demonstration environment for a 21-day trial. Each environment will support up to 12 workstations at once.

## Data and hosting

Demonstrations will load Synthetic Pack E and run in the Falcon Sandbox. Each environment will be reset after each session.

## Approval

The regional demo manager will approve every booking before access details are issued to the prospect.

# OpsAtlas pilot onboarding guide: Leeds distribution centre

This guide applies only to the OpsAtlas pilot at the Leeds distribution centre. Other pilot sites have their own guide.

## Who to contact

The site operations supervisor is the onboarding contact for every new pilot user at Leeds, and agrees each user's start date.

## Onboarding programme

Onboarding at Leeds lasts 5 onboarding days, including one night-shift session for warehouse teams. Sessions take place in the Bay 3 training room.

## Systems

Leeds pilot users raise questions and feedback through Kestrel Desk. Accounts are created on the first onboarding day.

## After onboarding

Users confirm completion with the site operations supervisor before using OpsAtlas on live shifts.

# OpsAtlas pilot onboarding guide: Bristol head office

This guide applies only to the OpsAtlas pilot at the Bristol head office. Other pilot sites have their own guide.

## Who to contact

The workplace services manager is the onboarding contact for every new pilot user at Bristol, and agrees each user's start date.

## Onboarding programme

Onboarding at Bristol lasts 3 onboarding days, run during office hours. Sessions take place in the Floor 6 briefing suite.

## Systems

Bristol pilot users raise questions and feedback through Merlin Portal. Accounts are created on the first onboarding day.

## After onboarding

Users confirm completion with the workplace services manager before using OpsAtlas in their team.
